summary: On paper Buffalo has the edge (Buffalo ranks 1st in EPA per dropback with motion, +0.14). The model favors Buffalo at 80%, mostly on starting QB (2.7 pts) and passing matchup (2.5 pts).

model.summary: Model: Buffalo 80% to win, fair line BUF -10. Market: Buffalo 73%. The largest factor is starting qb, worth 2.7 points toward Buffalo.
